scientific_integrity: Analytic identity derived for equally skilled on-serve probability 1/2, independent rallies, conventional doubles side-out service and uncapped win by two; exact-rational checks are corroborative and do not certify the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: No unequal server skill or modified rally scoring
Oscillation is infinitely often, not alternating on every consecutive target
Earlier equivalent derivation remains a bibliographic risk
No independent audit or priority certification
title: An exact Legendre law and infinitely many first-serve reversals in fair-rally pickleball
